timeline: Day 47: the city fell in one night
Alex alone on the rooftop at sunset with the glowing baton; helicopter overhead
Max warns: the horde found the bridge
The horde is seen moving through the ruined city and across rooftops
Radio mentions a safe zone; Alex plans to move at dawn, Max says dawn is too late
Rooftop chase; Alex and Max jump the gap between buildings

The bunker door is locked; the radio crackles with a strange signal
The bunker door opens by itself; glowing eyes in the dark; a voice says 'You shouldn't be here.'
